method: Point-in-time. For each symbol, all data after the cutoff was removed before estimating mu and sigma from the preceding two years. 10,000 GBM paths were then simulated 252 trading days forward from the cutoff close, and the resulting 80% band compared to the real adjusted close twelve months later.
interpretation: 16 of 20 landed inside the 80% band. On a well-calibrated 80% band you would expect about 16. 20 stocks is a small sample — read this as a sanity check that the bands are roughly the right width, not as proof of anything stronger.
missNarrative: The misses were HDFCBANK, ITC, TITAN and NESTLEIND — they moved further than price history alone implied. The model reads price history and fundamentals. It does not read the future, and it does not see news.
